title: Additional requirements for enlargements of buildings with no existing standpipe systems.
officialText:
Where the alteration involves the addition of stories to a building with no existing standpipe system, standpipes shall be provided to all stair shafts in accordance with this chapter.
Exception: Standpipes are not required where:
1. the alteration involves the addition of only one story;
2. the completed building does not exceed 7 stories; and
3. the completed building does not exceed 85 feet (25.9 m) in height.
